name: File Edit
description: Performs partial text replacement in a file. Finds old_string and replaces it with new_string. Fails if old_string is not found or matches multiple locations (unless replace_all is true).

inputs.name: File Path
inputs.description: The path to the file to edit (absolute or relative to working directory)

inputs.name: Old String
inputs.description: The exact text to find and replace. Must match exactly (including whitespace and indentation).

inputs.name: New String
inputs.description: The text to replace old_string with. Can be empty to delete the matched text.

inputs.name: Working Directory
inputs.description: The base directory for relative paths

inputs.name: Replace All
inputs.description: If true, replace all occurrences. If false (default), fail when multiple matches are found.

outputs.name: Edited Path
outputs.description: The absolute path to the edited file
